name: Bad Luck Club
description: Monthly social mahjong nights in Honolulu's Chinatown (Native Books / Arts & Letters Nu'uanu), about 40 attendees and up to 12 tables; Honolulu Magazine and FLUX Hawaii describe separate beginner and experienced tables. Neither article says whether the game is American / NMJL, so the style is unconfirmed. Instagram: @hibadluckclub.
